answer: At the zenith of Sybil resistance, recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments bind each agent to a sequential delay function whose entropy accumulates as unforgeable work, so identity cloning demands violating the underlying hardness assumption rather than merely regenerating keys. VRF leader sortition emits a signal that propagates this binding across epochs, and from dawn each commitment compounds, making spoofing information-theoretically infeasible against Byzantine adversaries.
